title: Healthy vending machines
summary: Fresh, healthy food in smart vending machines.
whyTempting: Junk-food vending is everywhere; healthy options are lacking.
whyItFails: Spoilage. Fresh food expires, destroying margins. Location economics. Good spots are scarce and owners take a cut. Restocking costs. Logistics for perishables are heavy.
whatWouldChange: Better demand prediction and placement in high-traffic captive locations like hospitals.

attempts.outcome: Shut down, then acquired by 365 Retail Markets
attempts.notes: Unmanned app-paid pantry boxes stocked with convenience-store items.

reasons.detail: Spoilage: Fresh food expires, destroying margins.
Location economics: Good spots are scarce and owners take a cut.
Restocking costs: Logistics for perishables are heavy.
